claims.text: Smartphones, social media, artificial intelligence, and virtual reality offer new opportunities for digital phenotyping in mental health.
Smartphones, social media, artificial intelligence, and virtual reality offer new opportunities for remote mental health interventions.
The i-PARIHS framework can be applied to analyze implementation challenges and opportunities for digital psychiatry innovations.

evidence.description: The authors detail how smartphones, social media, artificial intelligence and virtual reality present new opportunities for 'digital phenotyping'.
The authors detail how smartphones, social media, artificial intelligence and virtual reality present new opportunities for remote intervention.
The paper uses the Integrated Promoting Action on Research Implementation in Health Services (i-PARIHS) framework to explain how innovations, recipients, and context must be considered.

methodologies.name: i-PARIHS Framework Analysis
methodologies.description: Qualitative evaluation of digital psychiatry adoption through the Integrated Promoting Action on Research Implementation in Health Services framework.

limitations.text: Digital health technologies face significant real-world implementation barriers across patient, provider, and policy levels.

future_work.text: Address key implementation issues at the patient, provider, and policy levels to enable adoption in mental health care systems.
